request.description: Takes a version out of use; a published one falls back to the previous published version, or the rule stops matching. Open offers are not touched. Staff only. Routing rules are versioned config (same lifecycle as question sets): an ops lead makes, a different staff member approves in Change Requests, then it is published. Reading needs config read access; making, publishing and retiring need config maker access for routing rules (ops lead, super admin).

response.name: 200 OK
